name: a-count-question-is-a-build
turns: How many protein-coding genes does 3D7 have?
rationale: A question whose answer is a count is a request to build the set that answers it. The cataloged run read the question mark, classified the turn as a follow_up_question, and never offered the framing and building tools, so the count came from prose and no strategy reached the account. This pins the classification half no unit test can measure: the turn frames the problem and persists a strategy AST.

provenance.curatorNote: The prompt is the phrasing the classifier rule names.
